digest.component_or_area: LLM overlap/enrichment subsystem and event schema
propositions: Remove 2,280 LOC of cross-ticket overlap detector implementation (7 modules, CLI, prompts, schemas, config keys, env vars) that starved concurrent writers and is disabled upstream.

Retain the four event type names (TICKET_DIGEST, ENQUEUE_ENRICH, CLAIM_ENRICH, DONE_ENRICH) in _NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES and EVENT_TYPES so ~105k historical events still parse and compact preserves them.
Re-enable the create-time same-title duplicate journal by flipping rebar.toml suggest_duplicate_tickets from false to true, restoring _commands/recent_creates.py advisory-only warnings.
Remove all write-path enrichment queue hooks (event_append.py, push.py, attest.py, plan_review/__init__.py) that called maybe_drain after writes and enqueued ENQUEUE_ENRICH at certification.
